cases.title: Woman applicant, income above the cap, civil dispute - eligible under Section 12(c) irrespective of income
SC/ST applicant, criminal dispute - eligible under Section 12(a)
No protected category, income below the State limit, family dispute - eligible under Section 12(h) only
No protected category and income above the State limit - not eligible
Woman with a disability - both category sections apply, documents are merged and de-duplicated
Person in custody, income question not answered - eligible under Section 12(g)
Child applicant with an unlisted dispute type - eligible under Section 12(c); document list falls back to the generic dispute document
Victim of trafficking, criminal dispute - eligible under Section 12(b); FIR document appears once although two rules require it
Victim of a natural disaster, revenue dispute - eligible under Section 12(e) even though income is also below the cap (category takes precedence)
Industrial workman, labour dispute - eligible under Section 12(f)

description: Sample data and test cases for the LegalAid India eligibility rules engine (src/lib/eligibility.ts). Each case gives the three eligibility answers (categories, incomeUnderCap, dispute) and the expected verdict and document checklist. All persons named are fictional samples created for testing. Executed by tests/eligibility.test.ts (run: bun test).
